method.input: Existing saved16k noisy FLOAT WAV; shared read_audio/synthesize_audio framing and fixed4-hop delay compensation
method.inference: ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider; intra_op_num_threads=inter_op_num_threads=1; fresh recurrentstate per variant; all model edits in memory
method.reference: Existing saved CPU FLOAT WAV; original CPU rerun matched every float32 sample exactly
method.comparison: No extra delay, trimming, gain normalization or fitting before L2 comparison
method.precision: Full-clip L2 vs CPU and errorenergy calculations use float64 differences; relativeL2 vsFPGA and onsetgain retain original float32 diagnostic operations
method.onset_relative_l2: Derived from sqrt(variant onset errorenergy / FPGA onset errorenergy) * independently measured FPGA onset relativeL2
method.reproduction_script_guards: Before inference, verify recorded model/input/reference/audio-wrapper hashes; abort if the original CPU rerun does not match reference sample bits. Guards added after the recorded experiment; inference and metric calculations unchanged.

configurations.epsilon_zero: Only epsilon attributes of all8 LayerNormalization nodes set to0
configurations.state_bf16: All45424 recurrentstate elements rounded BF16 then converted back FP32 before every frame includingfirst
configurations.frontend_state_bf16: Only state[:128] (32 ERBnorm +96 spectrum norm elements) rounded BF16 before every frame
configurations.constants_bf16_state_bf16: All float32 ONNX initializers (including learnedweights and scalarconstants) rounded BF16 and stored FP32; all recurrentstate rounded BF16 before every frame

confirmed_semantic_mismatch.description: Compiler ignores ONNX epsilon. Shared LayerNorm subtracts mean then computes reciprocal RMS without addingepsilon.

limitations: Not a complete FPGA emulator: no IF8 convolutionweight conversion, hardware accumulatorprecision, LALU approximation, or per-operator intermediateBF16 rounding.
Counterfactuals do not prove structuralbug or exclude interaction of epsilon omission with other arithmeticdifferences.
Results apply to this single outlier and do not establish corpuswide sensitivity.
The epsilon omission barely changes this CPU output and does not independently explain the large FPGA onset error.
Simplified BF16state/constants counterfactuals reproduce less than0.9% of observed FPGA onset errorenergy.
